facts.event: Tilde 清晨醒来发现自己还活着，虚弱得像一层薄皮，望着伊莎贝拉下令揭去白灰后重见天日的壁画。
facts.relation: Tilde 与 Isabella（王后，已故，仅作宫廷记忆）
facts.numbers: one of the finest in the palace
facts.anchor: I stared at the walls of my chamber, one of the finest in the palace.

facts.event: 御医 Ziyan 告诉 Tilde 她流产了失去一个孩子，但其余损伤轻微，一两天内可复原。
facts.relation: Tilde 与御医 Ziyan（Merovin 可能的眼线）
facts.anchor: ‘You have lost a child,’ Ziyan agreed

facts.event: Ziyan 只索「掌权后的一份效忠金」便把配方羊皮卷交给 Tilde；她用 Merovin 的密文解出指示：接受 Ademar 的提议。
facts.relation: Tilde 与 Ziyan（御医）、Merovin（Geveran 间谍）之间的双重交易
facts.numbers: Only a retainer, when you rule
facts.anchor: ‘Only a retainer, when you rule,’ said Ziyan mildly

facts.event: 侍女 Muirenn 进门想逃，Marolyn 一把将她按跪在床边，长刀抵住后颈。
facts.relation: Tilde 与侍女 Muirenn、侍卫 Marolyn（主仆/护卫）
facts.anchor: Marolyn drew one of her long knives and pressed it to the back of Muirenn’s neck.

facts.event: Muirenn 供认毒是她按 Prince Egil 的精确指示所制，并供出 Dagobert 想让 Conrin 当国王、以及 Conrin 的党羽 Thedemer、Gundobar。
facts.relation: Muirenn 与 Conrin/Egil/Dagobert 的共谋关系
facts.anchor: ‘The high priest wants to lead the Synod with Conrin as king.

facts.event: Tilde 判 Muirenn 在城门前挨三十棍、留她在身边赎命，并放 Helwinde 自由。
facts.relation: Tilde 对两名 Setinis 女奴的审判与宽赦
facts.anchor: ‘Thirty strikes with a rod. Before the gate, where she will be seen.’

facts.event: Lady Ysel 来访，提出由 Ademar 出钱派三十名卫兵、由 Captain Perin 统领归 Tilde 私有；Tilde 接受。
facts.relation: Tilde 与 Ysel/Ademar 的政治结盟
facts.anchor: ‘Not the ones we offer. A good number, thirty, headed by Captain Perin.’

facts.event: Ysel 暗示 Liran 可能毒死了发妻 Isabella，Tilde 由此醒悟 Elise 也身处险境，等不到晚上就要行动。
facts.relation: Tilde 与 Elise（敌友之间，此刻被 Tilde 视为需保护者）
facts.numbers: her last letter was full of worry
facts.anchor: I believe she was also drinking wine when she died.
